name: Duke of Edinburgh International Award
tagline: The Duke of Edinburgh's International Award at ANS: Voluntary Service, Physical Recreation, Skills, and Adventurous Journey—globally recognised youth achievement at Bronze, Silver, and Gold.
description: Amnuay Silpa School is an Independent Award Centre (IAC) for the Duke of Edinburgh's International Award. The programme offers Bronze, Silver, and Gold levels through four sections: Voluntary Service, Physical Recreation, Skills, and Adventurous Journey (plus a Gold Residential project). Participants develop purpose, life skills, resilience, and community contribution in line with International Award standards. Registration and full school-specific details are on the official ANS DoFE website.
summary: Complete adventurous, service, and skills goals for an internationally recognised award.
location: See meeting points by award level
applicationQuestionsRaw:
Which Award level are you applying for (Bronze / Silver / Gold)?

Date of birth (to confirm age eligibility)

Why do you want to join the DofE International Award?

Have you previously completed any level of the DofE Award? (If yes, please specify)

Are you willing to commit time weekly to Volunteering, Physical, and Skills sections?

Do you have any medical conditions or considerations we should be aware of?

name: Student Council
tagline: Representing student voices and improving school life at ANS.
summary: Student voice, school events, and student-led projects at ANS.
description:
Student Council at ANS is the group that takes student concerns to staff. Year and house reps bring feedback from their year or house into meetings on Fridays at lunch in the boardroom.

Members help plan school events and fundraisers—booking, publicity, roles, and follow-through—not only the day of the event. The Council also meets with teachers and school leadership when something needs action at school level.

name: School Show Stage Crew
tagline: Join the backstage and production teams behind ANS School Show — props, refreshments, merchandise, tickets, lighting, and sound.
description: The School Show is a large scale performing arts production that brings together students from drama, music, and dance to create a full theatrical performance. Students collaborate through rehearsals, mini-show sharings, and performances to develop skills in acting, singing, dancing, technical theatre, and ensemble work. The club promotes teamwork, creativity, confidence, and commitment, culminating in a fully staged production performed to a live audience.
summary: Apply for Stage Crew teams that support the School Show production behind the scenes.
meetingTime: 3:45-5:45 Additional longer rehearsals are usually scheduled on Sundays, typically 11:00am–4:00pm

name: MUN
tagline: Model United Nations is a club that allows students to role play as delegates from different countries or as a historical person to debate global issues.
description: Model United Nations is a club that allows students to role play as delegates from different countries or as a historical person to debate global issues. This club allows for a stimulation of how an actual conference would proceed in the United Nations. Participants are able to develop public speaking, research, and negotiation skills, as well as collaborate with other delegates within the same stance, building connections.
summary: Debate global issues, draft resolutions, and represent countries in dynamic conference simulations.

name: Interact Club
tagline: A Global Movement of Young Leaders
description: Interact is Rotary International's youth programme at ANS: student-led service and leadership with support from Rotary mentors and teachers. Members organise fundraisers, school initiatives, and community projects as part of a worldwide network across 145+ countries—alongside hundreds of thousands of young people building skills that last beyond school.
summary: A global non-profit leadership club where students organize charity events, community projects, and create meaningful change.
contact: Line group invitation after first meeting
applicationQuestionsRaw: Name, Year, why they want to join the Interact Club, which roles (e.g. Treasurer, Secretary, Coordinators, Public Relations, Fundraising / events, Operators) would they like to join?

name: Eco Committee
tagline: The Eco Committee is a club which aims to raise environmental awareness on the importance of climate change, sustainability and what we can do together as a school.
description: The Eco Committee is a club which aims to raise environmental awareness on the importance of climate change, sustainability and what we can do together as a school. By participating in the Eco Committee, members will get the chance to take part in many roles and help us design the "Eco Fashion Show" - our annual big event. As a member of TASS (The Alliance of Sustainable Schools), we strive to do the best for ANS under the vision "one small contribution from everyone, leads to a greener environment and an impactful difference to the whole community."
summary: Drive sustainability initiatives and environmental awareness across the school community.
contact: Members will be invited to line group
applicationQuestionsRaw: - Name, Year group, why do they want to join the eco committee, how will joining this club affect them as an individual?

name: Student Enterprise Club
tagline: Turn ideas into real businesses—build products, sell on campus, and donate profits to school-supported charities.
summary: Turn ideas into reality through entrepreneurship, product creation, and real-world business experience.
description:
Turn ideas into real businesses. The Student Enterprise Club gives students in Years 7–13 the chance to build, launch, and sell real products on campus while learning how business works in the real world. Work in teams to create products, manage budgets, market your brand, and trade during weekly school breaks.

From pitching ideas to making sales, members gain hands-on experience in entrepreneurship, leadership, teamwork, and financial decision-making—all while supporting meaningful causes, as profits are donated to school-supported charities.

What you'll do:
• Build and pitch business ideas
• Design products and marketing campaigns
• Sell products during weekly trading sessions
• Manage budgeting, pricing, and profits
• Learn from guest entrepreneurs, parents, and alumni

Open to: Years 7–13
No prior business experience needed. Just creativity, commitment, and a willingness to learn.

This club is perfect for students interested in business, leadership, creativity, or making real impact.
contact: Message the student leader via school email or apply on ANSxtra.

name: Operation Smile
tagline: Operation Smile is a world-wide organization that provides patients, with cleft conditions and facial deformities, access to safe and comprehensive surgical care.
description: Operation Smile is a world-wide organization that provides patients, with cleft conditions and facial deformities, access to safe and comprehensive surgical care. During the academic year, our ANS club will work collaboratively to raise funds and awareness for this cause, through fundraisers and student-led projects. Members will also have opportunities to participate in medical missions, surgical programs and international conferences. We highly recommend this club to students who are interested in the medical field, however, all students from all years groups are welcome to join!
summary: Organise fundraisers and awareness campaigns to support safe cleft surgery and global medical outreach.

name: SPARK Club
tagline: The SPARK club aims to promote acts of kindness through offering experiences to those who may be less fortunate while also ensuring our students get hands-on activities based on their preferred interests and having a chance to step up and lead the projects.
description: The SPARK club aims to promote acts of kindness through offering experiences to those who may be less fortunate while also ensuring our students get hands-on activities based on their preferred interests and having a chance to step up and lead the projects. Members participate in service initiatives ranging from sports and arts to media and science, building leadership skills and making a positive impact in the community.
summary: Promote kindness and community impact through student-led initiatives and meaningful service projects.
contact:
Line: https://line.me/ti/g/cVqj3SKKLd
Instagram: @spark.ans (for contacting the leaders)
applicationQuestionsRaw: Name, Year group, old member/new member, why do you want to join SPARK club/your expectations of the club, field of interests (open to any whether its sports, arts, media, science, pr etc. Feel free to share!)

name: TEDx
tagline: TEDx Club is a safe and inclusive space for students to share ideas, perspectives, and stories that matter.
description: TEDx Club is a safe and inclusive space for students to share ideas, perspectives, and stories that matter. We believe that even small ideas can spark meaningful change. Members develop public speaking skills, collaborate on talks, and participate in the annual TEDx Amnuay Silpa School Youth event. The club welcomes diversity, encourages respectful listening, and empowers members to think boldly, speak confidently, and spread ideas worth sharing.
summary: Plan and deliver inspiring student-led talks that share ideas and spark meaningful conversations.
applicationQuestionsRaw:
Choose one TEDx Amnuay Silpa School Youth talk to watch and describe what you learned from the talk.
Interests, passions, and abilities(youtube link: https://www.youtube.com/live/Zr9k0QWJl-U?si=eHxhG2GiFHkn7hGd)

name: UNICEF Ambassador
tagline: UNICEF is a club committed to helping struggling children (e.g., children with disabilities, children in need of financial assistance, or children impacted by natural or political events).
description: UNICEF is a club committed to helping struggling children (e.g., children with disabilities, children in need of financial assistance, or children impacted by natural or political events) and ensuring their rights. Members organise campaigns and fundraising events, work with the Event team or Graphics design team, and support global humanitarian causes through direct assistance and sponsorship.
summary: Advocate for children's rights and organise campaigns that support global humanitarian causes.
applicationQuestionsRaw: Name, Year Group, House, Which group they want to join within UNICEF (Event team and Graphics design team)
